name: run-progress-bar
description: Live progress of long-running agent work above the prompt: task step, workflow phase, elapsed, ETA range, cost, anomaly flags.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the bar re-reads journals and file sizes.

stallMinutes.title: Stall threshold (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: Minutes without a journal event or file write before a running agent counts as stalled.

growthPercent.title: Output growth flag (%)
growthPercent.description: Percent growth of a watched file within 30 minutes that raises a flag.

costThresholdUsd.title: Cost flag (USD)
costThresholdUsd.description: Session cost at which the cost flag is raised; re-raised every 50 above it.

showWhenIdle.title: Show when idle
showWhenIdle.description: Keeps a dim one-line marker with the session cost above the prompt while nothing runs, so the bar is always there.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: classic = glyphs only. The others draw the session and the workflow's agents as small original avatars (role by label prefix, state by expression, a power level): saiyan = soft shapes with faces; pixel = 8-bit sprites; ink = brush strokes on paper; mecha = armour plates with a visor; neon = glowing outlines on dark glass.

watchFiles.title: Extra files to watch
watchFiles.description: Comma-separated absolute paths of output files to watch for growth.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Writes a per-tick snapshot to the mod's store and shows a load toast and counters; for troubleshooting.
